already_discord: This Discord account has already been imported.
already_fluxer: Your PokeFlux account has already received an import.
confirm: I understand this can only be done once
connect_body: Sign in with the Discord account you played EeveeCore on. PokeFlux only reads your account name and forgets it after 15 minutes.
discord_unchanged: Nothing changes on Discord. Your data is a copy of EeveeCore from 3 November 2026, so anything you get on Discord after that stays there. Each Discord account can be imported once.
error: Discord sign in did not work. Try again.
how_it_works: Your Pokémon are added after the {count} you already have, and your currencies and items are added to yours. Your selected Pokémon stays the same.
no_data: This Discord account has never played EeveeCore.
not_configured: Importing from Discord is not available yet.
not_started: Start playing PokeFlux first, then come back to import.
preview_failed: Could not read your Discord account: {error}
